clues: This city sits on the Öresund strait on the south west coast of Sweden. It is the biggest city in the far south of that land.
This far north city stays mild for its place on the map. A warm sea stream flows from far away and softens its cold months.
Back in 1353, this city won the rights of a true city. That step marks the start of its long life as a city.
The football club here has won more league crowns than any club in the land. It is the one north land club to reach the last match of the great cup of Europe.
A great bridge that was done in the year 2000 links this city to Denmark. Cars and trains cross it, the one fixed link to the main lands of Europe.
